informative.H1440_meaning: TOTAL depth from the root (includes H300): every H300 survivor continues the same branch to transition 1440 = 60 s from the intervention; 1,140 additional transitions after the certificate. Labels: H300 rescue (gate), H1440 endpoint survival + re-death offset/cause (descriptive). Finite-horizon witness, never proof of permanent rescue
informative.H300: transitions 1..300 from the root; rescue-positive root = bare branch dead by 300 AND >= 1 alternative alive after 300
informative.alternatives: every game-legal action plus the bare action (b2_engine.py:393); each branch forces that action at transition 1, then unchanged bare B8 with reacting FRP3+v8 opponents, same restored sim/opponent carry/RNG, no reseed, no respawn credit

reads_allowed_before_production: eligible candidate count / lives / lengths from the selector trace
reads_forbidden_before_production_merge: any root's alternatives / H300 / continuation outcome
canary.size: 1 excluded full-design trajectory (canary_seed at index 0), BL_B2_CANARY=1: serial == parallel branch bytes on every exercised root

expected_yield.conclusion: B2 as registered (<= 4 roots x 32) is expected to print INSUFFICIENT and more likely than not to return < 4 distinct rescue-positive lives. No unspecified value changes this. This is a sizing fact, never evidence that search has no value
expected_yield.cross_check_DENSITY_pilot: doom samples per eligible stride-200 root: frozen 1/85 = 1.2 %, mixed 2/51 = 3.9 %, scripted 3/94 = 3.2 %; witnessed-avoidable 0/1/1 (summary.json cells A). Consistent with 1-4 % doom, ~1-2 % rescuable
expected_yield.prevalence_T3_roster_L2prime: frozen 13 rescues x ~40.6 roots / 30,534 grid batches = 1.7 %; mixed 5 x ~37 / 30,159 = 0.6 %; pooled frozen+mixed ~1.2 % (own recount of 160 shard rows: batches 30,534/30,159/19,037; baseline deaths 23/11/17; rescues 13/5/10)
expected_yield.required_for_E8: p >= 6.25 % (5x the L2' frozen rate, 10x mixed); comfortable (90 %) needs p ~ 9 %
expected_yield.rescue_window_per_rescuable_death: M0 Part B (28/28): a - f for the 9 frozen+mixed rescues at L_f >= 800 = 235,135,285,280,290,175,285 | 230,255 frames (mean 241, min 135) => ~49 rescue-positive 5-grid roots per rescuable death (range 28-59); all 28 rescues: frozen mean 198, mixed 180
expected_yield.watch6_transfer: unmeasured (v8-vetoed FRP3 opponents; respawn resets length). Planning range p in [0.5 %, 2.5 %]

informative.hash_selection_rule: per trajectory keep the 4 smallest sha256('PLAN_v3/B2/root/v1', namespace, trajectory_index, life, frame) among eligible candidates (b2_units.py:60-64, b2_engine.py:365-383); selection completes before any alternative is evaluated; fewer than 4 eligible candidates => keep all, report deficit; no outcome, Q-margin, death-offset, danger-filter or life-balancing input of any kind
informative.mix_label: mixed (Watch6); satisfies the fixture bar's non-scripted (frozen/mixed) clause; no frozen stratum
informative.root_grid_rule: candidate decisions d = 0,5,10,...,14395 (decision % 5 == 0, selector frame = d+1); eligible iff hero alive and length >= 800 at the pre-action selector; grid is absolute across respawns (never reset); roots must be < trajectory_frames; branches continue past the parent endpoint
informative.schedule_PT: Sol binds values + ruling JSON Thu night/Fri AM (0.25 d), Codex-V 0.25 d; Claude: Mac tiny entrypoint preflight when the lease is free (not during X5 20:00-22:00; nice 10); canary Fri on slot C; production Sat on slots C+B (A stays P1); stage/verify each unit; one merge Sun; library before Mon Oct 26 12:00
informative.seeds_rule: b2_allocate.derive(round_index): 32 production + 1 excluded canary seed, sha256-derived from namespace/round/role; round_index = the lowest r >= 0 whose whole 33-seed allocation prints a CLEAR freshness audit (explicit banks, >= 7 training exclusions, history scan, positive controls, zero collisions); whole rounds only, never individual seed replacement; the design binds freshness_report_sha256 and allocation_digest
informative.trajectory_meaning: one continuous-respawn Watch6 session of 14,400 hero decisions (10 min at 24 fps); bare B8 s3 vs 5 x FRP3 s12 + v8, native kernel on and attested (stock_rows == fallback_rows == 0, kernel_rows == eligible opponent rows)

unit_timeout.rule: PLAN_v3 2x applied once; never doubled again; whole-session wall 14.25 min (base 7.125); >= 3 min reserved for setup/export/release; branch workers share the same deadline (b2_engine.py:396)

units_forecast.forecast_total: <= 8.6 u; worst case <= 16.2 u; envelope 20 u (original series incl. canary); all attempts incl. one mechanical completion <= 40 u; never doubled again
